subject: Intro demo & exec alignment — Brightline Systems

From: Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Intro demo & exec alignment — Brightline Systems

Hi Eleanor / Samir —

Great to meet you on the call last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a concise exec-facing demo to introduce Redwood's inference platform and align on where VP/CIO presence would be most valuable. Goal: 30–40 minute live demo + 10–15 minute exec Q&A (total 45–50 minutes).

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Dec 14 — 10:00–10:50 PT
- Wed Dec 15 — 09:30–10:20 PT
- Thu Dec 16 — 13:00–13:50 PT

Please tell us which of those works for your CIO and VP; if none, share two slots that do. If helpful, we can also split: a 20-minute exec intro (CIO/VP) + a 30-minute technical demo with product/infra leads.

If Priyom can't join the exec window, Marissa Cole will host as exec liaison — copying Marissa and Ava to confirm backup coverage and who will lead the technical deep-dive.

Attached: Brightline_RDQ.pdf (answers to your runbook questions) and demo_agenda_v1.docx (draft).

Notes:
- We prefer a live Teams link (recording OK if you share policy).
- We'll keep the exec portion focused on reliability, SLOs, and data isolation (VPC options).

Next steps: confirm attendee names + preferred slot and whether you want an NDA or pre-demo tech questionnaire completed.

Thanks —
Priyom

Marissa will lead the exec intro and highlight the VPC/private deployment controls; Vivek will cover latency/SLOs and fallback policies during Q&A. Ava will own calendar logistics and the Teams link.

Marissa / Vivek / Ava — can you confirm availability for Wed Dec 15 12:30–13:15 ET and whether you prefer to use our tenant Teams link or Brightline's? If we use Brightline's, please advise any allowlist domains/security checks and we'll route the recording policy to your security contact.

Also: I'll create a lightweight mutual action plan and send a DocuSign for any contractual follow-ups after the demo (no commitment during the session).

Thanks —
Priyom
